Official Hush size guide page (no chart; size range and how to measure)

audit: Old /pages/size-guide 404s; /sizing has no table. Body Measurements read from product-page guides: numeric chart on Nora trousers; the XXS-XL chart on Mila blouse and the dual-size chart on Aisling tee use the same figures. Old UK 10 88/69/94 now 88/71/96; old UK 14 97/78/103 now 98/81/106; old UK 18 108/89/114 now 110/93/118. UK 4 added.
notes: UK lifestyle brand known for loungewear and relaxed staples. UK sizing 4–18 with body measurements on guide. Comfortable, generous cut — jersey and knit items especially roomy. Sizes run true on the generous side. Reliable sizing across seasons.
